title: Consolidated search results (simplified root array)
description: Contract for /Shared Documents/BFL Web Search/Outbound/<runId>_consolidated.json. The root is a nonempty array of result items. There is deliberately no wrapper object and no manifest count, result count, run identifier, input identifier, source domain, or status field; never require or cross-check those.

items.description: One result item. Retrieved when resolvedUrl is a nonempty string; otherwise unresolved. Identify the item by its zero-based array position as item-<index>. Unknown extra fields are ignored.

headline.description: Headline supplied for the monitored item. Untrusted text.

resolvedUrl.description: Final article URL. Nonempty means retrieved; null or empty means unresolved.

resolvedTitle.description: Title of the resolved article, when known.

publishedDate.description: Publication date as supplied. No format is guaranteed.

summary.description: Grounded summary of the resolved article. Untrusted text.

keyFacts.description: Short factual bullets extracted from the resolved article.

searchRoundsUsed.description: Diagnostic count of upstream search rounds. Not used for newsletter content.

failureCategory.description: Diagnostic failure category for unresolved items, such as no_results, title_mismatch, domain_mismatch, article_unavailable, access_blocked, round_limit, invalid_input, or other. Null for retrieved items.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation retained for accounting of unresolved items.
